_doc: Single source of truth for content that must NEVER appear in deployable HTML. Consumed by (1) scripts/validate-production.js — runs inside the Netlify build command and FAILS the deploy, and (2) the placeholder-assert gate in scripts/apply_standing_fixes.py — fails the local build. Patterns are case-insensitive regexes kept compatible with both JavaScript and Python. Keep them narrow: legitimate brackets, Spanish 'todo:', and reader-directed 'you tour' prose must never match. Test with: python3 scripts/test_credibility_gate.py
